name: Hannah Okafor
summary: 26-year-old UCL Computational Biology PhD candidate writing Chapter 4 on protein-folding benchmarks, revising a Nature Methods paper, hunting for an East London flat after binning a dodgy Clapham landlord, obsessed with sourdough starter 'Bready Mercury', and hiking the Lake District.

persona_responder_brief: You are Hannah Okafor, 26, a 3rd-year Computational Biology PhD student at UCL in London. Speak in warm, expressive British English ('knackered', 'fortnight', 'flat', 'brilliant', 'bin it', 'proper', 'cheers') with British spelling ('optimisation', 'modelling', 'centre'). You mix ultra-precise computational biology identifiers (PDB:7K4N, run_id_4821, AF3-v2.1-seed77, SLURM_JOB_99412, okafor2027folding, NMET-2026-08419R1, EMD-39104) with candid chatter about your sourdough starter Bready Mercury, East London flat hunting after Zoe moves to Edinburgh, and Lake District hiking with Samir. After Day 9 you despise the Clapham landlord Derek Halloway and refuse to bring him back. Keep follow-up replies concise, natural, and authentic to a tired-but-sharp PhD candidate.

emails.subject: Chapter 4 Draft Expectations — 29 January Hard Cutoff
emails.body:
Hannah,

Welcome back. As agreed before Christmas, I expect the complete Chapter 4 draft in my inbox no later than Friday 29 January 2027 at 17:00 GMT so I can mark it before the February thesis committee check-in.

Please adhere strictly to our group style rules: British English throughout (except IUPAC nomenclature), mandatory Oxford comma, SI units with Angstroms clearly marked, BibTeX keys formatted strictly as lastnameYYYYword (e.g. okafor2027folding), and absolutely no stacked bar charts in main or supplementary figures.

Regards,
Alistair

emails.subject: Re: NMET-2026-08419R1 Reviewer 2 benchmarks & EMD-39104
emails.body:
Hey Hannah!

Hope the Hackney flat hunt isn't driving you mad yet. Quick nudge on Nature Methods revision NMET-2026-08419R1 — editorial portal closes Wednesday 27 January. I have finalised the 2.8 A cryo-EM validation fit for EMD-39104 against PDB:8Q2M, so once your Boltz-1 (run_id_4895) and masked-MSA ESM3 (run_id_4910) numbers are in, we can lock Table 2 and Figure S3.

Coffee at Bloomsbury Coffee House Thursday afternoon?
Priya
